summary: Shifts a date by an amount of a unit.
description: A new `Date` is returned; the one passed in is untouched. A negative amount moves backwards.
Adding a month keeps the day of the month where it exists and clamps it where it does not: 31 January plus one month is 28 February, not 3 March.

params.date: The date to read. It must be a valid `Date`.
params.amount: How many units to move. Negative moves backwards.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: an argument is not a valid `Date`.

examples.title: Shifting a date
examples.body:
```javascript
const start = new Date(2026, 0, 31);

offset(start, 1, "month"); // 28 February 2026 — the day is clamped
offset(start, -1, "day"); // 30 January 2026
```
